_provenance.note: Verbatim subset of NIST ACVP ML-DSA-87 sigGen DETERMINISTIC cases (pure interfaces only: external/pure, internal/mu, internal/message; HashML-DSA/prehash and hedged (non-deterministic) cases omitted, matching validate-acvp.ts scope). sk + signature are NIST published outputs, used to assert the engine SIGNS to the exact NIST byte string, not only that it verifies one.
